Package data

Class SubscriberReport

java.lang.Object
data.ReportManager
data.SubscriberReport
public class SubscriberReport extends ReportManager
Entity class representing a report for subscriber activity. This report includes daily statistics on the number of reservations and customers in the waiting list.
